thread.title: #I'm Looking For a Zombie • #Zombie Sagashitemasu - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Most commenters enjoyed the episode’s gentle, character-focused atmosphere and found the new ally appealing.
Several praised the cast’s supportive relationships and the way characters adapt to changing circumstances.
The updated opening and ending were widely noticed and emotionally effective for commenters.
Some appreciated the quieter pacing and everyday humor, while others found the episode mainly transitional.
A few commenters questioned the plausibility of the setting’s vehicle fuel and battery situation.
Some reactions expressed anxiety that the show’s generally cheerful developments may precede something tragic.
